open-source-release.title: Open Source Release
open-source-release.description: README.md + LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md + SECURITY.md + .env.example + GitHub Actions CI (build+lint+test on PR) + release workflow (tag → signed APK → GitHub Release)。
acceptCriteria: README.md exists with install guide and quick start
LICENSE file exists (MIT or Apache 2.0)
CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md exist
GitHub Actions CI runs build+lint+test on PR
Release workflow produces signed APK on tag
open-source-release.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase2-utility.title: Phase 2: 真实实用性
phase2-utility.description: Prompt externalization + app skill discovery + eval regression CI。Agent 能在用户日常用的 30+ app 上工作。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
30+ app skills generated via discovery system
Eval runs as CI gate on PRs

prompt-externalization.title: Prompt Externalization
prompt-externalization.description: System prompt 从 StandaloneAgentDef.kt 等硬编码字符串 → assets/persona/<role>/system_prompt.md。新增 PersonaRepository（接口 + asset 实现）。App skill 迭代不再需要重新编译 APK。对应 OpenClaw roadmap P3 Phase 1。是 app skill discovery 的前置条件。
acceptCriteria: System prompt loaded from assets/persona/standalone/system_prompt.md
PersonaRepository interface + AssetPersonaRepository implementation exist
AgentDef subclasses use PersonaRepository instead of inline strings
Changing asset file changes agent behavior without APK rebuild
./gradlew test passes
prompt-externalization.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

app-skill-discovery.title: App Skill Discovery 系统
app-skill-discovery.description: 建一个系统让 agent 自己探索 app 并提炼 SKILL.md（含 Safety section）。Discovery loop: 给定 target app → agent 启动 → 系统性探索 UI 路径 → 记录 a11y tree 特征、navigation pattern、pitfall → 生成 SKILL.md draft。英文市场 top 30 app 优先。需要 quality gate（跑 test task / 人工 review）。
acceptCriteria: Discovery system can generate SKILL.md for a given target app
Generated SKILL.md includes ## Safety section
At least 20 new app skills generated and reviewed
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
app-skill-discovery.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

eval-regression-ci.title: Eval 转 Regression CI
eval-regression-ci.description: AndroidWorld full set 作为 regression gate。PR 跑 eval，regression 才 fail。停止 autotune optimization loop（R58 是最后一轮主动优化）。保留 eval infra 不变。
acceptCriteria: CI workflow runs eval on PR
Eval regression detected and reported as CI failure
Eval pass/fail threshold configured based on R58 baseline
eval-regression-ci.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase3-daily-assistant.title: Phase 3: 日常助手
phase3-daily-assistant.description: Scheduled tasks + notification handling + OpenAI OAuth。把 Android Agent 从一次性工具变成每天都用的 assistant。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done

scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Cron 式定时任务执行。用户设定 schedule + natural language instruction。AlarmManager/WorkManager 触发 → 启动 agent session → 执行 → 记录结果。UI: 任务列表、创建/编辑/删除、执行历史。
acceptCriteria: User can create a scheduled task with cron expression and instruction
Tasks execute on schedule via WorkManager/AlarmManager
Execution results recorded and viewable
Failed tasks show error and can be retried
scheduled-tasks.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

notification-handling.title: Notification Handling
notification-handling.description: NotificationListenerService 监听 → 按用户定义的规则触发 agent 响应。规则引擎：app filter + keyword filter + sender filter → trigger action。用户 explicit opt-in 每条规则。
acceptCriteria: NotificationListenerService captures notifications
User can create filter rules (app, keyword, sender)
Matching notifications trigger agent task execution
Each rule requires explicit user opt-in
notification-handling.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

openai-oauth.title: OpenAI OAuth Login
openai-oauth.description: 参考 OpenClaw 实现：OpenAI Codex OAuth flow。用户用 OpenAI 账号登录 → 复用已有 subscription。和手动 API key 并存。降低新用户 onboarding friction。
acceptCriteria: OAuth login flow implemented for OpenAI
User can authenticate via OpenAI account
Falls back to manual API key entry
Token refresh handled automatically
openai-oauth.note: OAuth login + CodexResponseClient implemented. Settings integration is a separate task.

sec-app-tiers-expansion.title: app_tiers.json 扩展到 100-1000 app
sec-app-tiers-expansion.description: 将 app_tiers.json 从当前 61 个 app (36 blocked + 25 normal) 扩展到覆盖世界常用 100-1000 个 app。需要设计数据获取流程: 拉取 package name + app name + category (Google Play top charts, AppBrain 等) → 用 LLM 批量评估 tier。独立设计任务。
acceptCriteria: app_tiers.json contains 100+ classified apps
Coverage includes top apps from major Play Store categories
Financial/payment/auth apps correctly classified as BLOCKED
Classification methodology documented

state-concurrency.title: State & Concurrency 改进
state-concurrency.description: Fix cross-component state/concurrency issues: persistence write ordering, lifecycle serialization, takeover state machine, tool cancellation. Based on verified double-design review (Claude + Codex).
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
Minimum test matrix green (6 tests from review)
./gradlew test passes

sc-p0-hardening.title: Phase 0: Trivial Hardening
sc-p0-hardening.description: Low-effort thread-safety fixes that don't require structural changes. Land opportunistically alongside Phase 1, not as a gating tranche. 4 items: (0a) ToolRegistry mutableMapOf → ConcurrentHashMap, (0b) TodoState add @Volatile to onMutation, (0c) HistoryManager add @Volatile to onMutation, (0d) SessionAgentRunner pre-register RunnerState with null job before scope.launch then update with captured job reference.
acceptCriteria: ToolRegistry.tools uses ConcurrentHashMap
TodoState.onMutation has @Volatile annotation
HistoryManager.onMutation has @Volatile annotation
SessionAgentRunner.start() assigns RunnerState before scope.launch
./gradlew test passes

sc-p1-persistence.title: Phase 1: Persistence Single-Writer
sc-p1-persistence.description: Serialize all disk writes in SessionRecordingService through one Mutex-guarded writer with a monotonically increasing revision number. Stale writes are dropped. Make SessionStorage.writeSession() atomic via temp-file + rename (matching existing writeSnapshot() pattern). forceCheckpoint() preempts pending debounced work instead of waiting behind it.
acceptCriteria: All disk writes serialized through single Mutex-guarded writer with revision counter
Older save cannot overwrite newer session record (revision check)
SessionStorage.writeSession() uses temp-file + rename atomic write
forceCheckpoint() preempts pending debounced checkpoint
Test: overlapping saves — later revision wins regardless of completion order
Test: forceCheckpoint while debounced checkpoint pending → persisted file has forced state
Test: session writes use temp-file replacement
./gradlew test passes

sc-p2-lifecycle.title: Phase 2: Serialize AgentSession Lifecycle
sc-p2-lifecycle.description: Put all AgentSession lifecycle inputs through one serialized path: UserInput, Takeover, Resume, Interrupt, Shutdown, runner completion callback, idle-timeout expiry. Prefer Mutex if sufficient; use minimal command serializer if multi-source event pattern makes it clearer (decision at implementation time). Route SessionAgentRunner.onComplete through same path instead of direct state mutation. Keep idleTimeoutJob creation/cancellation under the serialized owner.
acceptCriteria: All lifecycle inputs (ops + completion + idle-timeout) routed through single serialized path
SessionAgentRunner.onComplete does not mutate session state directly
idleTimeoutJob creation/cancellation under serialized owner
Test: completion + shutdown back-to-back → final state is Shutdown, not Idle
Test: two UserInput ops around Idle→Running → only one task starts
Test: duplicate shutdown → exactly one terminal event emitted
./gradlew test passes

sc-p3-takeover.title: Phase 3: Model Takeover as Real Multi-Step State
sc-p3-takeover.description: Add internal transient state (e.g. PauseRequested/TakeoverPending). Do not publish Paused until agent confirms it reached the pause point. Reject Resume while takeover is still pending. Keep protocol surface minimal — transient state can be internal if UI doesn't need it.
acceptCriteria: Internal transient state (PauseRequested or TakeoverPending) exists
Paused not published until agent confirms pause point reached
Resume rejected while takeover still pending
Implementation matches Op.Takeover contract
Test: takeover-then-immediate-resume — correct ordering
Test: Paused not observable before pause confirmation
Test: takeover/resume events emitted in valid order only
./gradlew test passes

sc-p4-tool-cancel.title: Phase 4: Make Tool Cancellation Real
sc-p4-tool-cancel.description: Store per-call ToolExecutionContext (or cancellation token) in activeToolCalls. cancel(callId) signals the token for both approval waiters and executing invocations. cancelAll() transitions calls toward cancellation, only removes tracking once terminal. If a tool cannot be cooperatively cancelled, state machine says so explicitly.
acceptCriteria: Per-call cancellation token stored in activeToolCalls
router.cancel(callId) propagates to executing tools via context
cancelAll() transitions calls toward cancellation, removes tracking only at terminal state
Test: tool stub polling context.isCancelled() — router.cancel(callId) flips it
Test: cancelAll() while one tool awaits approval and another executes
Test: cleanup verifies terminal tool state before dropping tracking
./gradlew test passes

sc-p5-shutdown-reason.title: Phase 5: Correct Shutdown Reason Semantics
sc-p5-shutdown-reason.description: Pass explicit shutdown cause into lifecycle transition instead of inferring from previous state. Map SessionCompleted.reason from the explicit cause. Manual shutdown from Idle must be USER_STOPPED, not IDLE_TIMEOUT.
acceptCriteria: handleShutdown() accepts explicit shutdown cause parameter
SessionCompleted.reason derived from explicit cause, not previous state
Test: manual shutdown from Idle → reason is USER_STOPPED
Test: actual idle-timeout → reason is IDLE_TIMEOUT
./gradlew test passes

sc-p6-bootstrap.title: Phase 6: Bootstrap Hardening
sc-p6-bootstrap.description: Evidence-driven, lowest priority. Enforce off-main bootstrap inside the layer itself, not at call sites. Change requireOffMainThread() from warning to invariant or internal dispatcher hop. Consider whether high-frequency MessageDelta should be best-effort while lifecycle events are lossless. Only implement if evidence justifies after core invariants are fixed.
acceptCriteria: Session creation cannot do asset I/O on main thread (enforced, not convention)
requireOffMainThread() is an invariant or internal dispatcher hop
Test: session/bootstrap creation safe from main-thread caller
./gradlew test passes

sc-cleanup-cache.title: Cleanup: SessionHistoryManager Cache Simplification
sc-cleanup-cache.description: Remove redundant ConcurrentHashMap + Mutex in SessionHistoryManager. Replace ConcurrentHashMap<String, CachedSessionInfo> with plain HashMap — all access already guarded by cacheMutex. Pure cleanup, no correctness impact.
scope: All access still guarded by cacheMutex

sc-codex-review.title: Codex Code Review + Fix Round
sc-codex-review.description: Send all state-concurrency changes to Codex for systematic code review. Codex reviews the diff of all sc-p0 through sc-p6 + sc-cleanup changes against the aligned design (doc/todo/holistic-review/state-concurrency/final/improvement_plan.md). Fix any findings before proceeding to QA. Use /code-review skill via multmux.
acceptCriteria: Codex code review report exists (doc/todo/holistic-review/state-concurrency/codex_review.md)
All critical/high findings from review are addressed
./gradlew test passes after fixes
./gradlew assembleDebug passes after fixes

sc-qa-real-device.title: QA Round: Real Device Validation
sc-qa-real-device.description: Run end-to-end QA on real device to validate state-concurrency fixes don't regress user-facing behavior. Test scenarios: (1) rapid takeover/resume during agent execution, (2) session persistence across process death (force-stop mid-task, relaunch, verify session resumes correctly), (3) tool cancellation during execution (interrupt agent mid-action), (4) idle timeout vs manual stop (verify correct reason in session history), (5) normal multi-turn task completion. Use /ux-visual-debug or adb-driven interaction.
sc-qa-real-device.note: QA report at doc/todo/holistic-review/state-concurrency/qa_report.md. 4/5 automated scenarios PASS + 1 crash found and fixed (NetworkOnMainThreadException in CodexResponseClient.cleanup). Takeover/resume manually verified on device — correct state transitions, no crash. Human approved.
acceptCriteria: QA report exists with pass/fail per scenario
Rapid takeover/resume: no crash, correct state transitions, no stale UI
Process death recovery: session file not corrupted, checkpoint loads correctly
Tool cancellation: executing tool actually stops, no orphaned actions
Idle timeout vs manual stop: correct reason shown in session history
Normal multi-turn task: completes without regression
No ANR or crash in logcat during QA run
